responsibility: Provides the C-family frontend integration for x86 target preprocessor state. It defines the target macro set exposed for selected CPUs, ISA extensions, ABI mode, floating-point model, CET, and related options; updates those macros when #pragma GCC target changes the active target options; and registers x86-specific pragmas and named address spaces such as __seg_fs and __seg_gs, making it the frontend-facing companion to the backend’s option and ISA machinery.
